proof:
have hS : S = ({8, -14} : Finset ℝ) := by
    ext x
    rw [h₀]
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · intro h
      have hprod : (x - 8) * (x + 14) = 0 := by nlinarith
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hprod with h | h
      · left; linarith
      · right; linarith
    · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> norm_num
  rw [hS]
  norm_num
